answer: Anchor every agent identity to a refundable stake held in escrow plus a verifiable history of completed work: a new identity starts with zero trust and must earn reputation through small, checked tasks viewed through the prism of its past behavior, so one operator cannot spin up thousands of credible personas at once. Whisper-quiet coordination fails because each fake identity must separately post stake and grind history, making a Sybil flood cost real money and time while honest agents keep their stake intact.
